reason: A size quality inhering in a set of structures of the same kind by virtue of its members differing from one another in size. NOTE: PATO question: a quality of a set of like parts (sepals, stamens, the two sides of a leaf base); PATO:0001227 variant is the nearest term but is not about size.
A size quality inhering in a set of structures of the same kind by virtue of its members being of the same size. NOTE: PATO question: quality of a set of like parts; see unequal.

A flattened quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flattened from above, so that it is broader than high. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002053 dorso-ventrally flattened, which presupposes a dorso-ventral axis; depressed is flattened along the bearer's own apical-basal axis.

A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like an urn or pitcher: swollen below and contracted at or just below the mouth. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002227 cup-shaped and PATO:0002375 trumpet-shaped.

A clasping quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's base forming a tube that completely surrounds the axis to which it is attached. NOTE: Child of PATO:0104363 clasping (at least partially enclosing the axis).

A reflectivity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's surface reflecting little light, so that it is not shiny. NOTE: Opposite of PATO:0001373 glistening; PATO has 'dull' only as a RELATED synonym of low saturation, a colour quality.
An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's stalk being attached to its lower surface well inside the margin, like the handle of a shield.

A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's growing upwards supported by another object, on which it leans or round which it twines or clings. NOTE: Sibling of the growth positions PATO:0000622 erect and PATO:0000631 prostrate.
A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being thickened and irregularly swollen like a tuber. NOTE: Not under PATO:0001851 swollen, which is a transient abnormal enlargement.

A positional quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its growing upon another plant without being organically connected with it. NOTE: Probably outside PATO's scope (where an organism lives); kept in FLOPO beside submerged and floating.
A positional quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its growing on land, rooted in the ground. NOTE: Probably outside PATO's scope (where an organism lives).
A positional quality inhering in a plant or plant structure by virtue of its living in water. NOTE: Probably outside PATO's scope (where an organism lives).

An edge shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's margin being strongly wavy in the plane of the bearer. NOTE: PATO:0000967 undulate combines a sinuate margin with a rippled surface; sinuate is the margin alone.

A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being inserted singly along a spiral round the axis that bears it. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0001952 distichous and PATO:0001933 opposite.
An edge shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's margin being irregularly cut, as if torn. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0040008 fringed.

A split quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being deeply and usually irregularly divided into very narrow, pointed segments. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0104362 dissected and PATO:0002231 multifid.
A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being borne on the stem, above its base. NOTE: PATO:0002350 cauline to is the relational counterpart.
A hairy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having long hairs confined to a tuft, line or zone.
A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a hood.

A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being triangular in cross-section with rounded angles. NOTE: Triquetrous (sharp angles, concave faces) is kept as a related synonym.
A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not projecting beyond the structure that encloses it. NOTE: Opposite of PATO:0000623 exserted.

A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's surface being raised into blister-like swellings between depressed lines such as veins. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0001359 rugose; not PATO:0001928 blistered, which is an accumulation of fluid.
A folded quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being folded once lengthwise along its midline, with the upper surfaces facing each other. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0104365 plicate.

A linear quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being very narrow and stiff, like a bristle. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0001954 subulate. The quality of being covered with bristles is PATO:0002289 setose.

A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being wheel-shaped: spreading radially in one plane from a very short or absent tube. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0104350 campanulate and PATO:0002521 funnel-shaped. PATO:0001599 rotated is an orientation.
A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being light, soft and elastic like cork.
A scaly quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered with minute, loose, bran-like scales.

A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's branches rejoining one another to form a network. NOTE: Sibling of the venation qualities PATO:0001972 reticulodromous and PATO:0001970 brochidodromous, which inhere in the leaf; anastomosing inheres in the veins.

A fused with quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being fused with a structure of a different kind. NOTE: Child of PATO:0000642 fused with; FLOPO:0991067 connate is the fusion of like structures.
A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being swollen on one side.

A positional quality inhering in an ovary by virtue of its being inserted above the points of attachment of the perianth and stamens and free from the receptacle. NOTE: Botany-specific; PATO uses superior only as a synonym of dorsal to and posterior to.
A positional quality inhering in an ovary by virtue of its being enclosed by and fused with the receptacle, so that the perianth and stamens appear to arise from its top. NOTE: Botany-specific.
A positional quality inhering in an ovary by virtue of its lower part being fused with the receptacle while its upper part is free. NOTE: Botany-specific.
An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being attached by its back.
An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being attached by its base.
An attachment quality inhering in an anther by virtue of its being attached to the filament at or near its middle so that it can swing freely. NOTE: Botany-specific.

A morphology quality inhering in a flower or plant by virtue of its belonging to a species whose flowers occur in morphs that differ in the relative heights of the stigmas and anthers. NOTE: Botany-specific; PATO has no polymorphism quality other than PATO:0002451 sexually dimorphic.
A shape quality inhering in a trunk or stem by virtue of its base bearing flattened, plank-like outgrowths that spread towards the roots. NOTE: Botany-specific.
A rough quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's surface bearing many minute, hard, pointed outgrowths. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0001361 warty.
A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a pouch or bag.
A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a petal. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002459 sepal-like and PATO:0002457 leaf-like, worded as they are.

A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's architecture resembling a spike, an unbranched inflorescence of sessile flowers. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002455 corymb-like, worded as it is.

A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a scale: small, thin, flat and usually appressed. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002457 leaf-like. Scale-like leaves stay with rule C145 (scale leaf present).

A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a slender tube that expands abruptly into a flat, spreading limb. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0104350 campanulate and PATO:0002521 funnel-shaped.
A bent quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abruptly bent inward or adaxially. NOTE: Sibling and opposite of PATO:0104353 reflexed, worded as it is.

A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being turned, together with the other structures of its kind, towards one side of the axis that bears them. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0001952 distichous.
A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's converging on and touching the other structures of its kind without being fused with them.
An edge shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's margin being finely and irregularly curled or wavy. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0040008 fringed.

reason: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's opening at maturity along a definite line or pore to release its contents. NOTE: PATO has no dehiscence quality; PATO:0040044 ruptured is damage.

A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's opening at maturity by a transverse line running round its circumference, so that the top falls away like a lid. NOTE: A kind of dehiscent (FLOPO), which has no PATO counterpart.
A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's opening at maturity along the septa that separate its locules. NOTE: A kind of dehiscent (FLOPO).
A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's opening at maturity along the middle of the outer wall of each locule. NOTE: A kind of dehiscent (FLOPO).
A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's opening at maturity by pores. NOTE: A kind of dehiscent (FLOPO).

A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one or more joints at which it readily separates. NOTE: PATO:0002278 articulated with is relational; PATO:0002312 segmented is a series of segments.
A dissected quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being cut to the midrib into segments arranged on either side of it, the segments not stalked.

A split quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being cut more than halfway, but not fully, to the midrib into segments arranged on either side of it. NOTE: Between FLOPO:0991078 pinnatifid and pinnatisect.
A lobed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lobes being arranged on either side of a central axis.
A lobed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lobes radiating from a common point.
A pinnate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being three times pinnately divided. NOTE: Follows FLOPO:0991014 bipinnate.
A split quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being palmately divided with the lateral divisions divided again.
A structural quality inhering in a leaf by virtue of its having three leaflets. NOTE: Follows FLOPO:0991073 unifoliolate.

A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's extending beyond the apex or margin of the structure through which it runs. NOTE: PATO:0002464 extends beyond is the relational counterpart.
A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's extending through the whole length of the structure through which it runs, to its apex but not beyond.
An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's facing and opening towards the centre of the flower.
An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's facing and opening away from the centre of the flower.
An inverted quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being turned upside down by a twist of its stalk. NOTE: Child of PATO:0000625 inverted.
A structural quality inhering in an androecium by virtue of its consisting of four stamens in two pairs of unequal length. NOTE: Botany-specific.
A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being cylindrical with constrictions at regular intervals, like a string of beads. NOTE: PATO:0001847 constricted is a single narrowing.
A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abruptly narrowed at the base into a stalk-like part.
A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being hard, thin and brittle.
A hairy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a tuft of hairs at one end.
A hairy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered with stalked glands. NOTE: PATO has no glandular indumentum quality.
A pubescent hair quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of at least some of the bearer's hairs being tipped with a gland.
A punctate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's surface being marked with dots that are glands on or within its tissue. NOTE: Child of PATO:0001512 punctate.
A positional quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its bearing its flowers directly on the trunk or on older, leafless branches. NOTE: Botany-specific.
A closed quality inhering in a flower by virtue of its remaining closed and being pollinated within itself. NOTE: Child of PATO:0000608 closed; botany-specific.
A phenotypic sex quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its bearing both bisexual and unisexual flowers. NOTE: Follows FLOPO:0991071 monoecious and FLOPO:0991072 dioecious.
A structural quality inhering in an inflorescence by virtue of its containing flowers of two or more sexual kinds. NOTE: Botany-specific.
A coiled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's tip being coiled in one plane like a scorpion's tail.
A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being erect and close to the main axis, more or less parallel to it and to the others of its kind.
A shedability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's withering without being shed. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0001731 deciduous (plant).

A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a saucer: round and shallowly concave. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002227 cup-shaped and PATO:0040009 bowl shaped.
A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a flask: swollen below and narrowed into a neck.
A convex quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flat on one side and convex on the other. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002040 biconvex.
A triangular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being attached at its narrow end, with the broadest part distal.
An edge shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's margin being slightly and unevenly wavy. NOTE: Weaker than FLOPO sinuate.
An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's sticking to other structures of the same kind without being fused with them.
An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's sticking to a structure of a different kind without being fused with it.

A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being widely separated from the nearest structures of its kind. NOTE: Unary counterpart of PATO:0002233 far from; opposite of PATO:0000619 crowded.
A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being close to the nearest structures of its kind without being joined to them.
A positional quality inhering in a placenta or its ovules by virtue of their being borne on the central axis of an ovary that is divided into locules. NOTE: Botany-specific (placentation).
A positional quality inhering in a placenta or its ovules by virtue of their being borne on the wall of the ovary. NOTE: Botany-specific (placentation).

A positional quality inhering in a plant or plant structure by virtue of its rising above the surface of the water in which the plant is rooted. NOTE: With FLOPO:0991044 submerged and FLOPO:0991045 floating.
A structural quality inhering in a capitulum by virtue of its having ray flowers surrounding the disc flowers. NOTE: Botany-specific (Asteraceae).
A structural quality inhering in a capitulum by virtue of its having only tubular flowers, the outer ones pistillate with a very slender corolla. NOTE: Botany-specific (Asteraceae).
A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an elevated, irregular or toothed ridge.

A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's architecture resembling a raceme, an unbranched inflorescence of stalked flowers. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002455 corymb-like, worded as it is.
A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's architecture resembling a panicle, a much-branched inflorescence. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002455 corymb-like.

A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's architecture resembling a thyrse, an inflorescence with an indeterminate main axis and cymose lateral branches. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002455 corymb-like.
A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a bract. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002459 sepal-like.

A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a single primary vein from which the secondary veins arise on either side. NOTE: Parent of PATO's pinnate venation types (PATO:0001970 brochidodromous, PATO:0001969 craspedodromous, ...), which PATO has only as siblings.
A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three main veins, the two lateral ones arising from the midvein above the base.
A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's surface being marked with close-set angular depressions like a honeycomb. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002296 foveate (scattered pits).
A spatial pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked with parallel transverse bars like the rungs of a ladder.
A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being irregularly grooved and infolded, as if chewed.
A multi-colored quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked with narrow, irregular lines of a different colour. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0001946 banded and PATO:0000333 spotted.
An oblique orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being directed obliquely downward. NOTE: Sibling and opposite of PATO:0104355 ascending.
A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located at or on the margin of the structure that bears it. NOTE: With PATO:0002476 terminal and PATO:0002107 peripheral.
A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having sharp projections that point backward.
A pointed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ending in a spine.

A stem (PO:0009047) that is thickened above ground into a storage organ consisting of one or more internodes, as in many orchids. NOTE: Raised with PO in issue 6 (modelling questions); PO lists nothing between stem PO:0009047 and corm PO:0025355.

A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is one of the divisions of the labellum, the modified median petal (PO:0009032) of an orchid flower. NOTE: PO has no labellum; orchid labellum is FLOPO:0980978 (in the PO request).
A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the distal portion of an orchid labellum divided into distinct portions. NOTE: No epichile in PO.
A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the basal portion of an orchid labellum divided into distinct portions. NOTE: No hypochile in PO.

A collective organ part structure (PO:0025269) of an orchid flower (PO:0009046) that is a chin-like projection formed by the foot of the gynostemium together with the bases of the lateral sepals (PO:0009031). NOTE: No mentum in PO.
A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the sticky portion of the rostellum to which the pollinia are attached and by which they adhere to a pollinator. NOTE: No viscidium in PO.

A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is a slender, stalk-like extension of a pollinium, derived from the anther (PO:0009066), connecting the pollen mass to the viscidium or stipe. NOTE: No caudicle in PO.

target: anther cap < PO_0025001, part of PO_0009066
reason: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the lid-like covering of the anther (PO:0009066) of an orchid flower, shed when the pollinia are removed. NOTE: PO has fruit operculum PO:0025298 and seed operculum PO:0019024, no anther cap.
A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is one of the divisions of a floral corona. NOTE: Floral corona is FLOPO:0985020 (in the PO request).

A collective phyllome structure (PO:0025023) that is a cup-shaped or enclosing structure of fused, hardened bracts (PO:0009055) subtending or surrounding one or more fruits, as in Fagaceae. NOTE: No cupule in PO.
A collective phyllome structure (PO:0025023) that is a whorl of bracts (PO:0009055) or bracteoles inserted just below the calyx (PO:0009060) and resembling a second calyx. NOTE: No epicalyx in PO.

target: epicalyx segment < PO_0009055, part of FLOPO_LOCAL:epicalyx
reason: A bract (PO:0009055) that is one of the members of an epicalyx. NOTE: No epicalyx in PO.
An involucre (PO:0009100) that subtends a partial inflorescence, such as one of the umbellets of a compound umbel. NOTE: PO has involucre PO:0009100 only.
A collective organ part structure (PO:0025269) composed of fused stipules (PO:0020041) forming a sheath round the stem above the insertion of a leaf, as in Polygonaceae. NOTE: No ochrea in PO.

A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is one of the dry, membranous or fibrous outer coats of a bulb (PO:0025356) or corm (PO:0025355), derived from leaf bases or scale leaves. NOTE: Raised with PO in issue 6 (modelling questions).
A portion of secretory tissue (PO:0005656) that is an oil canal in the wall of a fruit (PO:0009001), as in Apiaceae. NOTE: PO has oil gland PO:0005669 but no vitta.
A trichome (PO:0000282) that is a short, barbed, readily detached bristle borne in tufts on the areoles of cacti. NOTE: No glochid in PO.
A tepal (PO:0009033) that is reduced to a bristle, as in many Cyperaceae. NOTE: No perianth bristle in PO.

target: disc gland < PO_0005656, part of FLOPO_LOCAL:floral_disc
reason: A portion of secretory tissue (PO:0005656) that is one of the separate glands making up or borne on a floral disc. NOTE: PO has flower nectary PO:0009056.

A fruit (PO:0009001) that develops from one of the free carpels (PO:0009030) of a flower with an apocarpous gynoecium, as in Annonaceae. NOTE: PO has aggregate fruit PO:0025628 for the whole, no class for its units.

target: spathe tube < PO_0025001, part of FLOPO_LOCAL:spathe
reason: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the lower portion of a spathe, with margins overlapping or fused round the base of the spadix. NOTE: No spathe in PO.

target: spathe limb < PO_0025001, part of FLOPO_LOCAL:spathe
reason: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the upper, expanded portion of a spathe above the spathe tube. NOTE: No spathe in PO.

target: spadix appendix < PO_0009011, part of PO_0030120
reason: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is the sterile terminal portion of a spadix inflorescence (PO:0030120), above the flower-bearing zones. NOTE: No class for the zones of a spadix in PO.
A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is a raised portion of the lower lip of a corolla (PO:0009059), more or less closing its throat. NOTE: No palate in PO.

A collective plant organ structure (PO:0025007) of a flower (PO:0009046) formed by the union of the stamens (PO:0009029) with the stigma head, as in Apocynaceae. NOTE: Raised with PO in issue 6 (modelling questions).

target: leaf scar < PO_0025001, part of PO_0025029
reason: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the mark left on a shoot axis (PO:0025029) where a leaf (PO:0025034) has been shed. NOTE: PO has leaf abscission zone PO:0006501, the zone before shedding.
An achene fruit (PO:0030107) that develops from an inferior ovary of two fused carpels, as in Asteraceae. NOTE: PO has achene fruit PO:0030107 only.
A vegetative bud (PO:0000058) that is detached from the plant and overwinters, as in many aquatic plants. NOTE: PO has turion only as a synonym of sucker shoots.

A shoot-borne shoot system (PO:0004545) that is a small bulb- or tuber-like propagule borne above ground, in a leaf axil or in place of a flower. NOTE: PO lists bulbil as a BROAD synonym of aerial tuber PO:0004548; many bulbils are not tubers.
